create.description: Register a new external project with its quick access modules.

create.endpointAgroFusionNote: This endpoint belongs to the AgroFusion auth service, not the external project API.
create.endpointDescRoles: The endpoint retrieves the list of available roles in the system, which are used to assign permissions and access levels to users. Results must be returned within an object with a data property containing an array of roles.
create.endpointDescTypeDocs: The endpoint retrieves the list of document types available in the system, which are used when registering or updating users. Results must be returned within an object with a data property containing an array of document types.
create.endpointDescSearchUser: The endpoint allows querying user information in the system using their email address.
create.endpointDescCreateUser: The endpoint allows an administrator to create a new user in the system. When creating the user, the system generates an activation token so the user can activate their account.
create.endpointDescActivateAccount: The endpoint allows activating a user account in the system through an activation token.
create.endpointDescServiceAuth: Allows making requests to protected endpoints from an external service using client credentials and the user's email, returns an access token. This endpoint must not be protected.
create.endpointDescChangeStatus: The endpoint allows modifying a user's status in the system, for example to activate or deactivate their access.
create.endpointDescEditUser: The endpoint allows an administrator to update an existing user's information in the system.
create.endpointDescSso: The endpoint allows a user with an active account to log in through AgroFusion.
